heading: Repealed. Pub. L. 101–392, title VI, § 602(a)(1), Sept. 25, 1990, 104 Stat. 840

notes.text: Section, Pub. L. 96–88, title II, § 213, Oct. 17, 1979, 93 Stat. 675, established the Intergovernmental Advisory Council on Education.

notes.heading: Effective Date of Repeal
notes.text: Repeal effective July 1, 1991, see section 702(a) of Pub. L. 101–392, set out as an Effective Date note under section 3423a of this title.
